More space.
Better locations.
Actually equipped.

Sentral communities are built differently. Expect larger units with full kitchens, in-unit washer and dryer, and designer furnishings that don’t feel like a hotel. Every building sits in a great neighborhood — walkable, vibrant, with retail and dining below you. Our fitness centers are bigger and better equipped than what you’d find anywhere else. Stay for a night or a year — either way, it just feels like home.
